finding: The prior compiler bound aggregate counts and caller-authored dispositions but had no immutable per-task state evidence. Two task states could be exchanged without changing any aggregate count, leaving an unverifiable task-to-outcome mapping.
resolution: require the canonical archived r9 research-harness state.json path and SHA-256
require the state batch ID and plan digest to match the retained campaign
require the state task-key set to equal population-001 through population-009
require every sidecar disposition to equal the corresponding harness task status
provide one canonical builder that derives all dispositions from state.json and self-validates the result before writing
fail closed when the state snapshot is absent, incomplete, changed, aggregate-inconsistent, or an output already exists

behaviors: accept a complete hash-bound task-state snapshot
derive all nine dispositions without caller-supplied statuses
reject per-task state swaps even when aggregate counts are unchanged

author_side_observation.test_environment: transient author workspace with import-only stubs for source files absent from the partial checkout

remaining_blocker: The repository archive does not yet contain runs/harness/population-gpu-current-r9/state.json. Local must copy the exact live or terminal state snapshot to the canonical path before the builder can emit the reconciliation sidecar.
